theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 := by
  cases n
  · rw [Nat.add_zero, Nat.mod_zero]
  · have : Even n ∨ Even (n + 1) := by exact Or.inl (Nat.even_add_one n)
    obtain (h | h) := this
    · have h1 : (n * n + n) % 2 = 0 :=
          by rw [Nat.even_iff]; exact Nat.even_mul_even n n
      exact h1
    · have h1 : (n * n + n) % 2 = 0 :=
          by rw [Nat.even_iff]; exact Nat.even_add_even n (Nat.even_iff.mp h)
      exact h1
